question: Across every never-served world edge in the six Q4 seeds, what is the association between final assertion and (a) ever forming a reported loop, (b) the edge's best full-universe prediction rank, and (c) its direct temporal count, with seed held fixed?

population.definition: Every world edge with served=false in .scratch/carrier_census.json: 180 edges over seeds 20611601-20611606, of which 26 are asserted.
population.outcome: asserted=true in the final structure, from the carrier census
population.complete_case: An edge must have a finite minimum full-universe rank; one count-4, never-asserted, no-loop edge has no rank and is excluded. The fit therefore uses 179 edges and 26 events.
population.no_imputation: Missing rank is not imputed; the excluded row is named in the result.

predictors.loop: Binary ever_loop from the census: at least one reported loop candidate contains the edge in either orientation in any of the 120 cycles.
predictors.rank: Minimum full-universe prediction rank across all 120 cycles, measured at cap 40 with the repaired observer. Lower is better. Analyzed as log2(min_rank), then standardized over the 179 complete cases.
predictors.count: Direct temporal count at the end of the run, from the census; standardized over the 179 complete cases.
predictors.seed: Six-level fixed effect; treatment coded with 20611601 as reference.
predictors.selection: No variable selection; all three predictors and seed enter once.

model.formula: logit P(asserted) = b0 + b_loop*loop + b_rank*z(log2(min_rank)) + b_count*z(direct_count) + seed fixed effects
model.estimator: Firth penalized likelihood (Jeffreys prior), because loop is quasi-separated: all 26 events have loop=1 and all 118 complete-case loop=0 edges are non-events.
model.why_firth: The ordinary MLE for the loop coefficient diverges under this zero cell. Firth returns a finite estimate; it does not turn the zero cell into evidence of an infinite effect.
model.penalty: 0.5 * log|X' W X|, with W = diag(p*(1-p)).
model.standardization: Complete-case mean and population SD; no outcome-based scaling.
model.convergence: max absolute Newton step < 1e-8, at most 200 iterations.

inference.primary: Firth Wald 95% confidence intervals for the three reported coefficients, from the inverse information at the penalized estimate.
inference.odds_ratios: exp(beta): loop is a 0/1 contrast; rank and count are per 1 SD. A rank odds ratio below 1 means a worse (larger) rank is associated with lower assertion.
inference.marginal_effects: Average marginal effects on the probability scale, computed at the observed covariates: loop 1 vs 0; rank +1 SD; count +1 SD.
inference.sensitivity: Leave-one-seed-out refits with the same full-sample standardization; the range of each coefficient is reported. No cluster-robust SE claim is made.
inference.multiplicity: One model, three reported coefficients; intervals are unadjusted.
inference.no_verdict: The model is descriptive. No coefficient-significance rule selects a verdict, and no causal claim is licensed.

expected_directions.loop: positive association; the sample has no asserted edge without a loop
expected_directions.rank: negative coefficient for log2 rank; a worse rank should reduce assertion
expected_directions.count: positive association; more direct transitions should increase assertion

gates.M1_population: 180 never-served edges, 26 asserted; no duplicate seed-edge rows
gates.M2_rank_coverage: at least 95% of never-served edges have a finite minimum rank
gates.M3_label_replay: the rank replay reproduces every census asserted and ever_loop label
gates.M4_loop_variation: both loop levels are present; the zero cell is disclosed, not hidden
gates.M5_convergence: the Firth fit converges with finite coefficients and information matrix
gates.M6_complete_predictors: every fitted row has loop, rank and count; no silent row loss
gates.M7_seed_levels: all six seeds contribute rows and the seed fixed effect is full rank

decision.reading: Report the three adjusted odds ratios, their intervals, the average marginal effects, the separation table, and the leave-one-seed-out ranges. A coefficient whose interval includes 1 is not read as an association.

labels.void: VOID: a gate failed; no coefficient is read

data_sources.rank_capture: A fresh replay of the same six Q4 seeds, 120 cycles, cap 40, using the repaired observer's full-universe call; each seed's asserted fingerprint and count match docs/assertion_provenance.json.

not_evidence: An observational model on one synthetic world family and six seeds, with 26 events. Firth stabilizes a separated coefficient; it does not establish causation, capability, retention, transfer, or a general engine property.
